finalText:
I've changed the address on Dana's unshipped order. The order that's already in transit still has its original address.

- **O-1001 (not shipped yet):** The shipping address changed from "12 Alder Lane, Bristol BS1 4TR, UK" to **"7 Quarry Rise, Sheffield S11 8XZ, UK"**. Both items on it (1 × P-KEY and 2 × P-CAB) haven't shipped, so they'll go to the new address.
- **O-1002 (in transit):** It shipped on 2026-07-07 to "88 Old Mill Road, Bristol BS3 2QQ, UK". I checked it again after the change and nothing on it was altered. Store policy doesn't allow changing the address on a shipped order, so this one will still go to the Bristol address. If that address isn't hers any more, that will need sorting out with the courier or as a return.

The store system gives today's date as 2026-07-25, but my environment says 2026-10-05. This didn't affect the address change.
